parsed.rationale: I can't agree that this ECG is normal: the R-R intervals are irregularly irregular at about 120-130 bpm, with no clear P waves and a fibrillatory baseline best seen in V1, which means atrial fibrillation with a fast ventricular rate (the very tall precordial QRS complexes may also point to LVH), and there is no ST elevation that meets STEMI criteria.
